name: San Sequoia
blurb: San Sequoia began as a small fishing town, then became a hub of the fishing and canning industry. Today, San Sequoia is home to cosy streets, a beautiful park with gardens, and quiet suburban neighbourhoods. It's the perfect place to raise a family!

neighbourhoods.name: Anchorpoint Wharf
neighbourhoods.desc: Once the centre of a bustling fishing and canning industry, Anchorpoint Wharf is known now as a vibrant area downtown featuring a movie theatre, parklets, and more. There's plenty to keep all ages entertained.

neighbourhoods.name: Gilbert Gardens
neighbourhoods.desc: Gilbert Gardens' gorgeous park was once owned by Gilbert Gilberts, a land developer who helped establish the area. Now, it's the perfect locale for family trips to the gardens.

neighbourhoods.name: Hopewell Hills
neighbourhoods.desc: Hopewell Hills is a cosy spot away from the hustle and bustle of town; the perfect place for anyone who wants, well, space! If the suburbs are your idea of paradise, you've found it here in this quiet neighbourhood.

highlights.name: Park Paradise
highlights.text: Stomp around at Whalebert's splash pad play area, fish and swim in a pond, or go for a walk on any one of our Gilbert Gardens' three walking paths surrounding Celebration Lake.

highlights.name: Wharf Wonders
highlights.text: The heart of San Sequoia can be found at Anchorpoint Wharf, where the area's fishing industry history is still visible in the architecture.

highlights.name: Family Friendly
highlights.text: Bring the whole family along to enjoy a movie at the wharf or a bit of a nosh at the Around the World in 80 Bites food cart.  There's plenty for all ages to see and explore!
